items.title: Live: Derryn Hinch to be farewelled at state memorial service in Melbourne
items.description: Derryn Hinch, the outspoken — and at times controversial — broadcaster and former senator, is being farewelled at a state funeral service in Melbourne after his death earlier this month, aged 82.

items.title: Quick hits: Trump crashes Spain's party, Argentina lose heads in defeat
items.description: Argentina's players lash out in defeat, Ferran Torres becomes a Spanish icon forever and Donald Trump attempts to crash the winners' party. Here are the World Cup final quick hits.

items.title: US launches more strikes on Iran, IRGC says two oil tankers hit
items.description: The US launches a new round of air strikes on Iran after announcing the death of another American service member, while Iran's Revolutionary Guard says two oil tankers have been immobilised in the Strait of Hormuz.

items.title: ASIC raises private credit alarm with 'every working Australian' exposed
items.description: The corporate regulator is concerned about the risks posed by private credit for Australians with superannuation.

items.title: Live: Taylor responds to Liberal's praise for One Nation's Malcolm Roberts
items.description: Angus Taylor distances himself from a Liberal senator's endorsement of One Nation's Malcolm Roberts. Follow live.

items.title: Alone, robbed and in pain: A man finds himself on Sydney's streets
items.description: People with lived experience of homelessness say the issue is deepening, as housing stock remains out-of-reach and community providers are left struggling to cope with demand.

items.title: For some in Australia, hope is fading and anger is rising
items.description: Sulaiman Zandinan says Australia is amazing. Wendy Newman says people in the bush are "not country bumpkins". The ABC is inviting you to have Your Say about the issues, challenges and opportunities that shape your life in 2026.

items.title: Abbott amplifies Hanson problem for Liberals
items.description: Pauline Hanson's grievance politics is a challenge for Labor, but a splitting headache for the Liberals — compounded by former prime minister Tony Abbott.

items.title: I tried to get unapproved injectables from a doctor. It was too easy
items.description: The booming industry selling Australians on treatments to live longer is exploiting significant gaps in health regulation, exposing consumers to risk.

items.title: Pauline Hanson 'not backing away' from controversial far-right interview
items.description: The One Nation leader was a guest on the podcast of controversial far-right UK figure Tommy Robinson, where she lamented the end of the White Australia policy.

items.title: President Trump Announces U.S. Military Airstrike in Venezuela
items.description: President Trump states the U.S. military conducted its first known airstrike inside Venezuela targeting a dock where drugs were allegedly loaded onto boats[1][2][4].

items.title: Trump Meets Netanyahu at Mar-a-Lago for Gaza Ceasefire Phase Two Talks
items.description: President Trump met with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu to discuss advancing phase two of the Gaza ceasefire, including reconstruction and responses to Iran[1][4].

items.title: Feds Launch Massive Taxpayer Fraud Probe in Minnesota After Viral Video
items.description: Federal agencies including DHS, FBI, and ICE investigate $110 million in suspected fraud at Minnesota child care centers following a viral YouTube video[3].

items.title: Americans Express Widespread Opposition to AI Data Centers
items.description: Public backlash against AI infrastructure data centers grows, with protests and demands for bans influencing Democratic Party strategies for future elections[3].

items.title: Elon Musk's Humanoid Robot Vision: China Poised to Lead Production
items.description: China prioritizes humanoid robots in tech race with U.S., ramping up production while warning of industry bubble and potential bottlenecks[3].

items.title: Trump-Putin Call Amid Ukraine-Russia Tensions Over Peace Plan
items.description: President Trump spoke with Putin amid ongoing Ukraine conflict, with Russia reevaluating peace plan tenets after Ukrainian denials[1].

items.title: Democratic Gubernatorial Candidates in Wisconsin Focus on Inflation and Trump
items.description: Seven Democrats vying for Wisconsin governor blame economic issues on Trump and emphasize affordability ahead of 2026 primary[3].
